name: Progresso Manhattan Clam Chowder (Tomato Acid WARNING)
whyItWorks: Tomato-broth base infused with diced bell peppers, celery, and rubbery, chewy clam pieces. The high titratable acid irritates the stomach while rubbery clams require excessive chewing.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Choose mild Chicken Noodle or Chicken Rice soup instead.
